title: Cisco reports Q1 revenue up 24% YoY to $18.5B, above $18.14B est., adjusted EPS above estimates, and raises its FY 2027 revenue forecast (Anzar Mehraj/Reuters)
summary: Anzar Mehraj / Reuters: Cisco reports Q1 revenue up 24% YoY to $18.5B, above $18.14B est., adjusted EPS above estimates, and raises its FY 2027 revenue forecast — Cisco (CSCO.O) beat Wall Street estimates for first-quarter results and raised its annual revenue forecast on Thursday, as the network-gear maker bets …
